notes: REF-BM-02: no server-side metadata fetch; title/description are typed by the user and preview image is never collected. Favicon is only derived client-side from the domain via a third-party service, not collected from the page. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable but there is no note field, so note editing is missing. REF-BM-06: createBookmark always INSERTs; no url dedup/unique constraint, so re-saving a url creates a duplicate. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain text field with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tags but there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax parsing; # is treated as literal LIKE text. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag or unread view; only a 'favorite' flag exists (not the same semantics). REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-scoped bulk action. REF-BM-22: list order is hardcoded (favorite DESC, created_at DESC); no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no note field or markdown rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag; delete is the only removal. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings for sort/items-per-page/font size.
